Running.note: Mono command, running tone, elapsed label and cwd — the structured header the roster is specified to show (no PTY bytes).

Finished.note: exitCode 0 renders the success tone with 'Finished', total runtime and pid.

ExitedWithError.note: Non-zero exit renders 'Exited (1)' in the destructive tone with pid and cwd on one line.

ClickableRoster.note: Clickable variant covering all four status branches including exitCode null → muted 'Exited'.
